abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.description: Heals a friendly target for 44.

abilities.name: Mark of the Wild
abilities.description: Increases the friendly target's armor by 34 for 60 min.

abilities.name: Wrath
abilities.description: Causes 15 Nature damage to the target.

abilities.name: Moonfire
abilities.description: Burns the enemy for 8 Arcane damage and then an additional 12 Arcane damage over 9 sec.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.description: Heals the target for 32 over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Thorns
abilities.description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 3 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.description: Roots the target in place and causes 20 Nature damage over 12 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. You may only have 1 target Rooted at a time.

abilities.name: Bear Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 30, Armor contribution from items by 180%, and Health by 180. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Roar
abilities.description: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 46. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Growl
abilities.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.description: Increases the druid's next attack by 18 damage.

abilities.name: Nature's Grasp
abilities.description: The next 1 melee attacks that strike the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 1). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.

abilities.name: Teleport: Moonglade
abilities.description: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.description: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.description: Heals a friendly target for 87 and another 91 over 21 sec.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Stuns the target for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.description: Cures 1 poison effects on the target.

abilities.name: Aquatic Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Aquatic Form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Aquatic Form (Passive)
abilities.description: Increases swimming speed by 50% and allow's the druid to breathe underwater.

abilities.name: Swipe
abilities.description: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 18 damage.

abilities.name: Faerie Fire
abilities.description: Decrease the armor of the target by 175 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

abilities.name: Hibernate
abilities.description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 20 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

abilities.name: Cat Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Cat Form, increasing Attack Power by 12 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Claw the enemy for 110% normal damage plus 27. Awards 1 combo points.

abilities.name: Feral Charge
abilities.description: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec. Leap behind an enemy.

abilities.name: Insect Swarm
abilities.description: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Prowl
abilities.description: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled.

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 400 health and 700 mana.

abilities.name: Rip
abilities.description: Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power: 1 point : 44.4 damage over 12 sec. 2 points: 70.8 damage over 12 sec. 3 points: 97.2 damage over 12 sec. 4 points: 123.6 damage over 12 sec. 5 points: 150 damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Shred
abilities.description: Shred the target, causing 155% damage plus 22 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo points.

abilities.name: Starfire
abilities.description: Causes 81 Arcane damage to the target.

abilities.name: Soothe Animal
abilities.description: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Beast targets level 40 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.description: Rake the target for 23 damage and an additional 48 damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo points.

abilities.name: Remove Curse
abilities.description: Dispels 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.description: Brings a dead player back to life with 160 health and 300 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilities.name: Tiger's Fury
abilities.description: Requires Cat Form Increases Physical damage done by 15% for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Abolish Poison
abilities.description: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Dash
abilities.description: Increases movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

abilities.name: Challenging Roar
abilities.description: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Cower
abilities.description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

abilities.name: Tranquility
abilities.description: Regenerates all nearby party members within 20 yards for 87 every 2 sec for 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Travel Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Travel Form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Ferocious Bite
abilities.description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 1 additional damage. Damage is increased by your Attack Power. 1 point : 50-66 damage 2 points: 86-102 damage 3 points: 122-138 damage 4 points: 158-174 damage 5 points: 194-210 damage

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.description: Ravage the target, causing 350% damage plus 147 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo points.

abilities.name: Track Humanoids
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

abilities.name: Frenzied Regeneration
abilities.description: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.description: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 90 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo points.

abilities.name: Pounce Bleed
abilities.description: Bleeding for 15 damage every 3 sec.

abilities.name: Primal Bite
abilities.description: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 38 and generating a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Dire Bear Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 120, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 600. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Feline Grace
abilities.description: Reduces damage from falling.

abilities.name: Hurricane
abilities.description: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 68 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks of enemies by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Innervate
abilities.description: Increases the target's Mana regeneration by 400% and allows 100% of the target's Mana regeneration to continue while casting. Lasts 20 sec.

abilities.name: Moonkin Aura
abilities.description: Increases spell Critical Strike chance by 3%.

abilities.name: Barkskin
abilities.description: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Gift of the Wild
abilities.description: Gives the Gift of the Wild to all party and raid members, increasing armor by 324, all attributes by 14 and all resistances by 20 for 60 min.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.description: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 60 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.description: Heals the target and their party for 420 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yds of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

abilities.name: Auto Shot
abilities.description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

abilities.name: Raptor Strike

abilities.name: Aspect of the Monkey

abilities.name: Serpent Sting

abilities.name: Arcane Shot

abilities.description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 26. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.

abilities.name: Concussive Shot
abilities.description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Hawk
abilities.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 20. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Call Pet
abilities.description: Summons your pet to you.

abilities.name: Dismiss Pet
abilities.description: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.

abilities.name: Feed Pet
abilities.description: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.

abilities.name: Revive Pet
abilities.description: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

abilities.name: Tame Beast
abilities.description: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

abilities.name: Track Humanoids
abilities.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Distracting Shot
abilities.description: Distract the target, causing threat.

abilities.description: Heals your pet 20 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Wing Clip
abilities.description: Inflicts 5 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye

abilities.name: Eyes of the Beast

abilities.name: Mongoose Bite

abilities.name: Disengage

abilities.name: Freezing Trap
